requirement: X_Q=(s1,s2,alpha,beta,gamma) must be built from MTS Q/Qcoh/S/eigenframe data before EM readout.
reason: prevents arbitrary EM variables being relabelled as Q-shear

requirement: Eigenframe angles and transitions must be smooth/covariant on U_reg, with repeated-eigenvalue support excluded or bounded.
reason: keeps Pi4 from hiding discontinuous chart choices

requirement: Pi4:X_Q->Y_Q must be fixed by the parent action or symmetry before EM data/readout, with rank(DPi4)=4 where generic EM rank is claimed.
reason: keeps the four Clebsch scalars from being fitted post hoc

requirement: q_X=(q_obs,X_Q) or q_Y=(q_obs,Y_Q) must be declared as the actual parent observed quotient/refinement, with projection back to the old q_obs.
reason: makes dY_Q[V]=0 legitimate rather than a kernel trick

requirement: All old sector readouts must factor through q_X by ignoring X_Q, or explicitly declare safe dependence on X_Q.
reason: prevents a new hidden preferred-frame/readout channel

requirement: The B_Q[X_Q] EM sector, charged current, EM Hilbert stress, binding/apparatus stress, and boundary terms must remain one descended source-action object.
reason: prevents EM stress from becoming an unaccounted source leak

requirement: X_Q must not couple directly to matter/source normalization outside the accounted EM/Hilbert sector, unless that coupling is separately bounded.
reason: prevents Q-shear ownership from acting like a fifth force

requirement: q_*, Z_EM, lambda_A, epsilon_J_Q, boundary/domain, and clock/material markers must be zeroed or bounded under the same q_X branch.
reason: keeps alpha/R10/clock claims closed until the whole local EM coupling is calibrated
